title: Reconcile to the latest harness release
goal: NERV runs the latest project-harness release, reconciled once the template backlog is empty
acceptance: Started only once the project-harness template backlog is empty (external prerequisite; harness 10.9.0 has no cross-repository dependsOn)
.harness.json names the latest release and every copied, forked and adapted file is reconciled
Every NERV check passes on the reconcile PR
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, endpoints or personal data in Git.
escalation: A harness rule that conflicts with a project override goes to the owner
Do not start while the template backlog still has open work
